name: 力场解构者武器 Forcebreaker Weapon (BMT)

description.value:
武器（任意造成钝击伤害的武器），极珍稀

你用这把魔法武器发动的攻击检定与其伤害掷骰具有+2加值。这把武器专门设计为解构魔法力场结构所用，例如@UUID[Compendium.dnd5e_classpack.spell.Item.juLb5PHooXitZDWI]{力场监牢 Forcecage}或@UUID[Compendium.dnd5e_classpack.spell.Item.31jKHMGJ0vlqdvQU]{力场墙 Wall of Force} 创造的那些。这把武器会自动击碎其打击的任何至大大型的魔法力场结构。如果目标是巨型或更大体型的力场结构，这把武器会击碎其20尺立方的部分。

（译者注：此处的“结构”意在“固定的立方状隐形监牢”或是“一面看不见的力墙”这样的东西，护盾术、法师护甲等很显然不属于此类内容。此外，后文使用的打击为“Strike”而非“Attack”，可能是想说不需要攻击检定。）

You gain a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon.

This weapon was crafted to destroy structures made of force, such as those created by @spell[Forcecage] or @spell[Wall of Force]. Striking a Large or smaller structure of magical force with this weapon automatically shatters that structure. If the target is a Huge or larger structure of force, this weapon shatters a 20-foot-cube portion of it.

Base items. This item variant can be applied to the following base items:

  • @item[Club|PHB] (@item[Forcebreaker Club|BMT])
  • @item[Flail|PHB] (@item[Forcebreaker Flail|BMT])
  • @item[Greatclub|PHB] (@item[Forcebreaker Greatclub|BMT])
  • @item[Light Hammer|PHB] (@item[Forcebreaker Light Hammer|BMT])
  • @item[Mace|PHB] (@item[Forcebreaker Mace|BMT])
  • @item[Maul|PHB] (@item[Forcebreaker Maul|BMT])
  • @item[Quarterstaff|PHB] (@item[Forcebreaker Quarterstaff|BMT])
  • @item[Sling|PHB] (@item[Forcebreaker Sling|BMT])
  • @item[Staff|PHB] (@item[Forcebreaker Staff|BMT])
  • @item[Warhammer|PHB] (@item[Forcebreaker Warhammer|BMT])
  • @item[Wooden Staff|PHB] (@item[Forcebreaker Wooden Staff|BMT])
